features.title: Download progress, pause controls, and detail navigation
features.user_visible_behavior: The detail view shows live progress for the active download. The downloads view supports per-item and global pause/resume, and clicking a task returns to the corresponding detail.
verification: Run the VanmoCore download model and state-machine tests.
Build and launch the Vanmo-macOS Debug app.
Inspect the Light/Dark Figma download screens and five task states.

features.title: Validate download recovery and detail navigation with a real media source
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can download movies and episodes from a real SMB or HTTP source, pause and resume without duplicate queue entries, and return from the downloads window to the correct detail and episode.
verification: Connect to a readable SMB or HTTP media source.
Queue one movie and 2–3 episodes from the same series, confirming that no duplicate tasks appear.
Pause individual and all tasks, restart the app, resume, and confirm that progress continues from the existing .part files.
Click movie and episode tasks in the downloads window, confirming that the existing main window is activated and navigates to the correct detail or episode.
Record the media source type, passing steps, and failure logs without credentials or complete authenticated URLs.
features.notes: This is a manual acceptance item for the existing download optimization, not authorization to expand implementation scope. Mark it passing only after the complete real-source flow succeeds.
